text:
BLAST+ rewrites NCBI's BLAST to fix suboptimal speed for very long queries/database sequences and command-line interface shortcomings. Long queries are chunked for processing, sometimes dramatically shortening runs; for long database sequences (contigs, chromosomes) only relevant parts are retrieved, reducing CPU and memory. Masking information is now retrievable from BLAST databases; a modular library accesses subject data from arbitrary sources; strategy files let users save/reuse options and be uploaded/downloaded at NCBI's BLAST site. Speed improves substantially for long queries and chromosome-length databases.

CLUSTAL W improves progressive multiple-sequence-alignment sensitivity for divergent proteins via sequence weighting (down-weight near-duplicates, up-weight divergent), divergence-varied substitution matrices, residue-specific gap penalties with locally reduced penalties in hydrophilic regions (favoring gaps in loops), and reduced penalties at early-gap positions. Freely available.
